title: Emission and absorption spectra of hydrogen
caption: Hot hydrogen gas emits light only at certain wavelengths: bright lines on black. Cool hydrogen in front of a white light absorbs exactly the same wavelengths: dark lines on the continuous spectrum. The lines match because each corresponds to the same energy gap, ΔE = hc/λ.
alt: Two spectrum strips from 380 to 720 nm: emission with coloured lines at 410, 434, 486 and 656 nm on black, and a full rainbow with dark lines at the same positions.
description: Emission: violet 410, violet 434, blue-green 486 and red 656 nm lines on black.
Absorption: a continuous rainbow with dark lines at 410, 434, 486 and 656 nm.
